climate: Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A South Australian zone with five regions inside it: Currency Creek, Kangaroo Island, Langhorne Creek, McLaren Vale and Southern Fleurieu.
